ordering.question_1: How do I place an order?
ordering.answer_1: Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can either create an account for faster future orders or checkout as a guest.
ordering.question_2: Can I modify my order after placing it?
ordering.answer_2: Orders can be modified within 1 hour of placement. Please contact our customer service team immediately at {email}.
ordering.question_3: Do I need an account to place an order?
ordering.answer_3: No, you can checkout as a guest. However, having an account makes future orders easier and allows you to track your order history.
ordering.question_4: What payment methods do you accept?
ordering.answer_4: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

shipping.answer_1: Orders are dispatched within {dispatch} business days, and delivery usually takes {delivery} business days after dispatch. The shipping cost depends on the size of the package and is shown at checkout before you pay.
shipping.answer_2: We deliver to the countries offered in the address form at checkout. The shipping cost is calculated there from the size of the package, before you pay.
shipping.question_3: How can I track my order?
shipping.answer_3: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order by logging into your account and viewing your order history.
shipping.question_4: What if my package is damaged or lost?
shipping.answer_4: If your package arrives damaged or is lost in transit, please contact us immediately. We'll work with the shipping carrier to resolve the issue and ensure you receive your items.

returns.answer_1: You may withdraw from your purchase within {days} days of receiving the goods, without giving any reason. To do so, send us a clear statement of your decision, quoting your order number. Some products are excluded from the right of withdrawal by law; details are on the Shipping & Returns page.
returns.answer_2: The direct cost of returning the goods is borne by you, unless the item is defective or we sent you the wrong item: in those cases we bear it. Please contact us before sending anything back.
returns.question_3: How long does it take to process a refund?
returns.answer_3: We refund the amount you paid, including the original delivery cost, within {days} days of receiving your withdrawal statement, to the payment method you used. We may withhold the refund until we have received the goods back or you have provided proof that you have sent them.
returns.question_4: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
returns.answer_4: We do not process direct exchanges. If you would like a different size or colour, withdraw from the original purchase as described above and place a new order.

account.question_1: How do I create an account?
account.answer_1: Click the "Register" button in the top right corner of our website. You'll need to provide your name, email address, and create a password.
account.question_2: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
account.answer_2: Click the "Forgot Password" link on the login page. Enter your email address and we'll send you instructions to reset your password.
account.question_3: How do I update my account information?
account.answer_3: Log into your account and go to "Account Settings" where you can update your personal information, addresses, and payment methods.
account.answer_4: Yes! You can save multiple shipping and billing addresses in your account for faster checkout. Just go to "Account Settings" > "Addresses".

general.question_1: How can I contact customer service?
general.answer_1: You can reach us by email at {email} or use our contact form.
general.answer_2: We strive to offer competitive prices. If you find a lower price on an identical item from a competitor, please contact us and we'll do our best to match it.
general.answer_3: Yes, we take your privacy seriously. We use SSL encryption, secure payment processing through Stripe, and never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.
general.question_4: Do you have a physical store?
general.answer_4_no_address: We are an online retailer and do not run a public store. Please contact us by email or through our contact form.
general.answer_4: We are primarily an online retailer, but we do have a customer service center at {address}. Please contact us before visiting in person.

settings.shipping.default_country.label: Default country
settings.shipping.default_country.help: Pre-selected at checkout. Must be one of the destination countries.
settings.shipping.carriers.label: Carriers
settings.shipping.carriers.help: Carriers you can pick when shipping an order. Use {number} in the tracking link where the tracking number goes.
settings.shipping.free_threshold.label: Free shipping from
settings.shipping.free_threshold.help: Orders whose items total (after discount) reaches this amount ship free. 0 = off.
settings.orders.min_amount.label: Minimum order amount
settings.orders.min_amount.help: Orders below this total cannot be placed. 0 turns the limit off.
settings.orders.max_qty_per_line.label: Maximum quantity per product
settings.orders.max_qty_per_line.help: Most units of one product in an order. 0 means no limit beyond the available stock.
settings.orders.guest_checkout_enabled.h: Off: customers must sign in to buy, and the guest checkout button is hidden.
settings.orders.public_link_days.label: Order link validity
settings.orders.public_link_days.help: How long the secure order link in emails stays valid.
settings.orders.order_notes_max.label: Order note length
settings.orders.order_notes_max.help: Maximum characters customers can write in the order note.
settings.inventory.low_stock_threshold.h: Products with this many units or fewer are flagged as low stock in the admin and on wishlists.
settings.catalog.per_page.label: Products per page
settings.catalog.per_page.help: Between 6 and 60. Applies to the shop and category lists.
settings.reviews.auto_approve.label: Publish reviews automatically
settings.reviews.auto_approve.help: On: new reviews appear at once. Off: they wait for your approval.
settings.email.enabled.label: Send customer emails
settings.email.enabled.help: Master switch. Off: no order email is sent, whatever the switches below say.
settings.email.order_confirmation.label: Order confirmation
settings.email.order_shipped.label: Shipping notice
settings.email.order_shipped.help: Sent when the order is marked as shipped, with the tracking link.
settings.email.order_delivered.label: Delivery notice
settings.email.order_delivered.help: Sent when the order is marked as delivered.
settings.email.order_cancelled.label: Cancellation notice
settings.email.order_cancelled.help: Sent when an order is cancelled.
settings.email.order_refunded.label: Refund notice
settings.email.order_refunded.help: Sent when a refund is recorded.
settings.email.back_in_stock.label: Back in stock
settings.email.back_in_stock.help: Sent when an item in a customer's cart or wishlist is available again. Customers can turn it off in their account or from the email.
settings.tracking.auto_deliver.label: Mark as delivered automatically
settings.tracking.auto_deliver.help: On: when the carrier reports delivery, the order becomes delivered and the delivery email is sent. Off: you update the status yourself.
settings.seo.default_description.label: Default description
settings.seo.default_description.help: Meta description for pages that do not set their own.
settings.seo.keywords.label: Default keywords
settings.seo.keywords.help: One keyword or phrase per entry.
settings.system.withdrawal_days.label: Withdrawal period (days)
settings.system.withdrawal_days.help: Statutory right of withdrawal quoted in emails and policy pages (EU minimum: 14).
settings.system.stripe_configured.label: Stripe payments
settings.system.stripe_configured.help: Whether the Stripe keys are present in the environment. The keys themselves are never shown.
settings.system.mailer.label: Mail transport
settings.system.tracking_driver.label: Tracking provider
settings.system.tracking_driver.help: Source of shipment updates (manual means links only).
settings.system.queue_connection.label: Queue connection
settings.system.queue_connection.help: Where background jobs such as emails are processed.
settings.system.queue_health.label: Queue status
settings.system.queue_health.help: Result of the last scheduled queue check.
Minutes a job may wait before the queue is reported as stuck.
settings.system.queue_alert_failed_thres: Number of failed jobs that triggers an alert.
settings.system.job_retries.label: Job retries
settings.system.job_retries.help: Attempts, time limit in seconds and waits between attempts for email jobs.
settings.system.scheduled_tasks.label: Scheduled tasks
settings.system.scheduled_tasks.help: Recurring jobs run by the server scheduler.
settings.system.rate_limits.label: Rate limits
settings.system.rate_limits.help: Maximum requests per minute on protected routes.
settings.ui.title: Settings
settings.ui.description: Configure the shop. Changes apply immediately.
settings.ui.no_changes: Nothing to save: no value was changed.
settings.ui.save_failed: The settings could not be saved. Please try again.
settings.ui.reset_done: The setting was reset to its default.
settings.ui.reset_confirm_body: The saved value will be removed and the default will apply again.
settings.ui.confirm_body: This setting has a wide effect on prices, checkout or emails. Do you want to save it?
settings.ui.column.name: Name
settings.ui.validation.member_of: Must be one of the values of ":other".
settings.ui.history_error: The history could not be loaded.
settings.ui.switch_group_body: You have unsaved changes in this section. If you continue they will be lost.
settings.ui.url_needs_number: The link must contain {number} where the tracking number goes.
settings.ui.sizes_link: Manage box sizes and shipping costs
